movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used primarily as responsive sensors and structural supports rather than decorative gestures; grasping is minimized in favor of continuous rolling contact.
movement_profile.footwork: Uncodified, shifting fluidly between barefoot floor contact, weight-bearing lunges, and suspended flight.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Fluid multi-directional pathways across the floor, often operating inside a circular 'round robin' boundary.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: The primary fulcrum for weight exchange; rolling along the ribcage, pelvis, and back to share and redirect gravitational mass.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Constant transitions from floor-level rolls and prone positions up through athletic jumps, shoulder lifts, and falls.
movement_profile.partnering: Continuous physical contact, exchanging body weight, counterbalancing, lifting, and tumbling in duet.
movement_profile.posture: Relaxed, alert, and grounded with softened joints, ready to yield to gravity or absorb a partner's weight.

signature_moves.description: Standing meditative exploration paying deep attention to micro-weight transfers and postural corrections.
signature_moves.name: Small Dance

signature_moves.description: Spherical floor tumbling technique adapted from martial arts to dissipate impact safely.
signature_moves.name: Aikido Roll

signature_moves.description: Assuming a quadrupedal position on hands and knees to support a partner's mass across the back.
signature_moves.name: Table-Top

signature_moves.description: Rolling across the floor beneath a partner who rolls on top, exchanging continuous surface contact.
signature_moves.name: Surfing

signature_moves.description: Balancing and shifting mutual trajectory while maintaining a contact point between skulls.
signature_moves.name: Head-to-Head Improvisation

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fluid and onflowing, shifting unpredictably between absolute stillness, slow rolling, and explosive athletic collisions.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiffening joints, clinging with gripping hands, forcing choreographic intentions, or neglecting the partner's balance and safety cues.

music_profile.sound_description: Contact Improvisation has no set instrumentation, score, or tempo described in primary sources. Jams and stagings frequently unfold in complete acoustic silence punctuated only by audible breath, feet sliding on wood, clothes brushing against canvas or skin, and the dull thuds of body weight dropping onto sprung floors or mats.

basic_steps: Small Dance: Stand upright in stillness, eyes open or soft, noticing micro-weight shifts and postural adjustments along the vertical axis.
Aikido Roll: Soften knees, curve the spine diagonally, and roll smoothly across the floor across the diagonal of the back without striking bony prominences.
Table-Top Support: Drop to hands and knees with a stable spine, allowing a partner to drape or roll their torso across the back.
Rolling Point of Contact: Make physical touch with a partner's arm, back, or shoulder; move together without sliding, rolling the contact point continuously across surfaces.
Surfing: Lie prone or crawl slowly while the partner drapes across the back, transferring weight and sliding over your rolling form.
teaching.formation: Duets embedded within an open circle or peripheral group in a 'round robin' jam structure.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on somatic awareness, safe floor rolling, releasing muscle tension, and sensing the partner's weight before attempting lifts or dynamic drops.
teaching.rhythm: Non-metric; tempo and phrasing are determined entirely by breath, gravity, inertia, and physical momentum.
